text: Given valid X-Plaid-Client-Id/X-Plaid-Secret/X-Plaid-Env headers and products=["transactions","auth"], when plaid_create_link_token is called, then it returns a non-empty hosted_link_url and link_token
Given a request with X-Plaid-Secret omitted, when any tool is called, then it returns HTTP 401 with a body listing all three required header names, and the body contains no secret value
Given a link_token whose Hosted Link session has not completed, when plaid_get_link_session is called, then it reports status=pending with no public_token
Given a Hosted Link session completed by a human tester in a browser, when plaid_get_link_session is called, then it reports status=completed with a public_token and institution name
steps: Call plaid_create_link_token with a real Plaid Sandbox client_id/secret
Open the returned hosted_link_url in a browser
Complete the flow against a Plaid Sandbox test institution (e.g. ins_109508 / user_good / pass_good)
Call plaid_get_link_session with the same link_token
expect: status=completed, public_token is a non-empty string, institution.name matches the one chosen in the browser
notes: needs a real vendor account (Plaid Sandbox signup) and a human to click through Hosted Link; not a blocker per SOP "no test account != blocked"

text: Given a link_token created with an already-elapsed url_lifetime_seconds, when plaid_get_link_session is called, then it reports status=expired

Given a public_token from /sandbox/public_token/create, when plaid_exchange_public_token is called, then it returns a non-empty access_token and item_id, and the access_token value never appears in the server's log output for that request
Given a valid access_token, when plaid_get_accounts is called with refresh_balances=false, then it returns accounts each with a balances object, served from Plaid's cached endpoint

Given the same access_token, when plaid_get_accounts is called with refresh_balances=true, then it returns the same accounts via the live-balance endpoint (distinct upstream call path from TC7, asserted against a request stub in unit tests)
Given a valid access_token and no cursor, when plaid_sync_transactions is called, then it returns a non-empty added list and a next_cursor
Given the next_cursor from TC9 with no new sandbox activity since, when plaid_sync_transactions is called again with that cursor, then added/modified/removed are all empty and has_more is false

Given two concurrent requests carrying different client_id/secret pairs against stubbed upstream responses, when both are handled at once, then each response contains only its own request's stub data and no state object is shared between the two contexts

Given an access_token for an Item linked only with the transactions product, when plaid_get_investments_holdings is called, then it returns an invalid_argument error envelope naming the missing product, not an exception
Given an Item without the liabilities product enabled, when plaid_get_liabilities is called, then it returns the same class of structured invalid_argument error

Given plaid_remove_item is called with confirm=false (or omitted) and a valid access_token, when the call is made, then it returns an invalid_argument error asking for confirm=true and no request is sent to Plaid

Given plaid_remove_item is called with confirm=true and a valid access_token, when the call succeeds, then a subsequent plaid_get_item call with the same access_token returns an item-not-found-shaped error

Given a stubbed upstream returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 1 twice then succeeding, when a tool call is made, then the client retries twice honoring the header and returns the successful result, with elapsed time close to 2s

Given a stubbed upstream returning HTTP 429 on every attempt, when a tool call is made, then the client retries up to its cap and returns a rate_limited, retryable=true error envelope rather than hanging past the call budget
Given the server has started, when tools/list is called, then it returns exactly 11 tools matching the Data & API contract table, none with a description over 500 characters or a first line over 100
notes: snapshot test, not tied to a single functional AC beyond AC1's tool surface
